narr: Heavy downpours accompanying afternoon showers and thunderstorms on June 25th led to one instance of flooding in Dickenson County. High water was observed for a brief period of time at a local intersection, but quickly drained away once the showers and storms came to a close for that day.
ev: High water was observed at the intersection of Coeburn Road and Honey Camp Road.
lsr: HIGH WATER ACROSS ROAD NEAR INTERSECTION OF COEBURN ROAD AND HONEY CAMP ROAD.
CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLASH FLOOD REPORT FROM 2 SW CLINTWOOD. HIGH WATER ACROSS ROAD NEAR INTERSECTION OF COEBURN ROAD AND HONEY CAMP ROAD.
